attrs.remaining_trust: That  is the product-level input set. A product that consumed another product WITHOUT declaring it would be invisible to this graph — the edge simply would not exist, and the graph would be acyclic for the wrong reason. Nothing here derives reads from the command; they are authored. That is the same authored-surface trust the impact lattice carries per edge, and it is why FAC-DERIVATION-CLOSED is open rather than a stronger form of this claim.
attrs.rule: complete enumeration of a finite domain that is DEFINED by the artifact under test
